## codex重置预测看板 2.0.0

汇总五个网站的重置预告，显示本机 Codex 剩余额度。你的套餐有了定时的自动重置预告后，看板切换为橙色，红色“游泳线”随时间推进，方便安排重置前的使用。

- 三条消耗横条：实际消耗、自定义 X 天重置节奏、个人周期均匀节奏；可拖动排序。
- 红线在预告时刻到达 100%；多个时间形成双线与红色荧光范围。
- 五个信源并列查看预计时间、原帖和更新时间。
- 展开历史记录，逐站比较时间和来源。
- 中英双语、字号调整、托盘监控、开机启动与持续通知；相近时间消息合并。

下载下方的 Windows x64 安装版或便携版即可使用。个人额度需要本机安装并登录官方 Codex CLI，步骤见 [中文说明](https://github.com/zzy2670/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)。发行包未签名；SHA256SUMS.txt 可用于核对文件。

[七语言图文介绍](https://zzy2670.github.io/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/) · GPL-3.0-only

## English

Follow reset announcements from five websites alongside your remaining Codex quota. A scheduled automatic reset for your plan turns the dashboard orange and adds a red pacing line to help plan your usage before the reset.

- Compare actual usage with a custom X-day reset cycle and even personal-cycle pacing. Drag the bars to reorder them.
- The red line reaches 100% at the announced time. Different times form two lines with a glowing red band.
- Read expected times, original posts and updates from five sources side by side.
- Expand history records to compare each site's timestamp and feed.
- English and Chinese, text size controls, tray monitoring, Windows startup and persistent notifications. Similar reset times are grouped together.

Choose the Windows x64 installer or portable executable below. Personal quota needs the official Codex CLI installed and signed in; see the [installation guide](https://github.com/zzy2670/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/blob/main/README.md). Binaries are unsigned. Use SHA256SUMS.txt to check the download.

[Feature tour in seven languages](https://zzy2670.github.io/codex-reset-forecast-dashboard/) · GPL-3.0-only
